layout.body:
To: brownchocolove@dmail.com
From: santos.apartments@dmail.com
Date: 05/22/2025
Subject: Maintenance Request
Dear Mr. Brown,
Your maintenance request has been received. Our technician will visit your apartment on June 10th between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM. You must be present during that time, as our policy is that only the primary tenant can let the technician in.
Best regards,
Maria Santos

questions.stem: What is the earliest time of day that the technician will arrive?
questions.analysis: What is the earliest time of day that the technician will arrive? 原文依据：Our technician will visit your apartment on June 10th between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM. 技术人员将于 6 月 10 日下午 1 点到 3 点之间上门。 (A) 上午 10 点 → 错误 (B) 上午 11 点 → 错误 (C) 下午 1 点 → 正确 (D) 下午 3 点 → 错误

options.A: To sign off on completed work
options.B: To provide details about the problem

questions.analysis: Why must Mr. Brown be present? 原文依据：only the primary tenant can let the technician in. 只有主租户才能给技术人员开门。 (A) 为完工工作签字 → 错误 (B) 提供问题详情 → 错误 (C) 给技术人员开门 → 正确 (D) 完成调查 → 错误
